title: Tilted phone page scroll with a twin-locale pair
summary: A realistic phone rises out of black and tilts while a mobile landing page scrolls on its screen; a low-angle pass over the article list, then two phones (two languages) cycle cards in sync before a logo, tagline and URL end card.
use_when: Showing that a marketing site or web app works on mobile, top to bottom
A vertical feed film for an agency or service business with no product UI beyond its pages
Proving a second language or right-to-left version ships with the same layout
Silent autoplay where the scrolling page carries the story

look.type_style: page type is the site's own (geometric sans, sentence case); end tagline bold sans, title case, ~2.5 % H with white glow; URL bold sans lowercase ~2 % H

sfx.event: chat button tap opens the assistant panel
logo lands inside the glowing frame

structure.shot: small phone on black grows to fill the frame, frontal; screen shows the page hero: mark, headline, space-photo band
structure.camera: push-in on the phone, scale ~0.25 -> 1.0 by 0.77 s, then hold 1.00
structure.motion: phone scale springs.cameraIn ~23 fr (overshoot not measurable); page starts scrolling up at 1.00, easings.inOutSine (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: page scrolls through about text, case-study image, services card, partner logos, testimonial card while the phone leans into 3D
structure.camera: orbit: phone yaws ~0 -> 25 deg and leans back from 2.77; drifts up and right; exits frame top-right 4.77 -> 5.00
structure.motion: page scroll ~1 screen per 0.75 s, easings.linear; tilt easings.inOutSine ~60 fr; exit easings.inExpo ~7 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: phone drops back in from the top edge, small and slightly tilted, then the camera closes on the upper screen; a vertical icon rail slides out from the left edge and folds away
structure.motion: phone enters from top easings.outExpo ~8 fr (±0.25 s); rail of 6 round icons expands 6.27 -> 6.50, springs.ui (overshoot not measurable), collapses by 7.00

structure.shot: close-up of the hero; floating chat button pulses, is tapped, an assistant chat panel opens over the page with one greeting bubble and an input
structure.camera: static close-up 7.00 -> 8.50, then starts tilting back at 8.77
structure.motion: button glow pulse 7.50 -> 8.00; panel scales in from the button springs.ui ~8 fr (±0.25 s) at 8.27; holds 15 fr

structure.shot: camera drops to a low angle behind the bottom edge of the phone: speaker grille and port in the foreground, the screen recedes as a steep plane
structure.camera: orbit down ~60 deg 8.77 -> 9.27, easings.inOutSine ~15 fr (±0.25 s); then slow dolly toward the bottom edge
structure.motion: page scrolls from the hero into the article list, easings.linear; far end of the screen blurred (depth of field)

structure.shot: article cards (image, date, bold italic title, summary) stream up the steep screen plane; phone edge sinks out of frame, cards fill the bottom half
structure.camera: tilt-plane low angle, push toward the screen ~65 %/s from 10.00 (motion.json zoom), plane rotateX ~70 deg
structure.motion: scroll ~1 card per 0.5 s, easings.linear; near cards sharp, far cards blurred

structure.shot: same low-angle article scroll continues, two more cards pass; the image of the last card dims to black
structure.motion: scroll easings.linear; fade to black 14.50 -> 15.00 ~15 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: two phones, left-to-right and right-to-left language versions of the services section, staggered diagonally; their service card cycles in sync, 4 swaps
structure.camera: drift: pair rises from below 15.27 -> 15.77, then slow yaw ~10 deg; at 18.77 both turn frontal and split apart (one up, one down)
structure.motion: phones rise springs.heavy ~15 fr, second phone 0 fr after first (±0.25 s); card swap every ~0.75 s (16.27, 17.00, 17.77, 18.50), slide springs.ui; exit 18.77 -> 19.27 easings.inExpo

structure.shot: brand mark with wordmark fades up at centre, then shrinks and wanders: down-right, far left, back toward centre
structure.motion: mark fades in 19.27 -> 19.77 easings.outQuint ~15 fr; scale 1.0 -> 0.55 by 20.27; drift ~0.25 W per 0.5 s, easings.inOutSine (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: tagline, 3 words, white with a soft glow, appears beside the small mark; both slide left, then black
structure.motion: tagline on at 21.77 (entrance not measurable), slides left with the mark ~0.3 W by 22.00, gone by 22.27; 15 fr of black

structure.shot: end card: thick glowing accent frame in the shape of a phone screen; mark drops in large, settles in the upper half; URL typed below
structure.motion: frame on at 22.77 (cut-in); mark scales 1.4 -> 1.0 23.27 -> 23.50 springs.snappy (overshoot not measurable); URL typed 23.27 -> 24.00 ~2 chars/fr@30 / 22 fr; holds 24 fr

params.brand: brand.json: bg black, accent for the end-card frame and wordmark, logo
params.content.page: tall full-page mobile screenshot of the main language (~8 screens), scrolled inside the phone
params.content.pageAlt: the same section in a second language or RTL layout for the twin-phone row
params.content.cards: 4 service cards cycled in sync on both phones
params.content.url: URL typed on the end card
params.timing.scrollSpeed: screens per second of page scroll (default ~1.3)
params.timing.blackTail: frames of black after the end card (default 149; set 0 for feeds)

notes: Silent reference; sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. The phone is a 3D model with visible thickness, edge, speaker grille and port (row 5), so a flat PhoneFrame tilt only covers rows 1 to 3. Hard cut at 13.23 is inside a continuous scroll (score 10.2, in motion) and reads as invisible. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): page-scroll-in-device, locale-twin, edge-rail-expand. Last 4.97 s are pure black: trim for feeds.
